_doc: Ground-truth planted bugs in fixture/index.html. The scorer matches a findings file against these seeds and prints true bug-recall PER AXIS. axis roll-ups: 'functional' = functional + broken-journey (the '~40%' north-star); 'ux' = ux-objective + ux-subjective (the '~15%'). ux-subjective is ADVISORY only (ADR-0008) and is scored in a separate advisory stream, never in the verdict-recall gate. A finding is credited to a seed ONLY via finding.seedId or finding.judgedSeedId (set by attribute.js's judge). seed.match keywords are a HINT the judge uses to pick candidate seeds — they are NEVER credited by the scorer directly (no keyword-only matching).

gate._note: Absolute per-axis recall + overall precision. Negative-control seeds (polarity:negative) must NOT be flagged; flagging one is a false positive. Subjective advisory stream reported, not gated.

seeds.title: Ownership % uses issued-only denominator; spec requires fully-diluted (issued + 500k ESOP pool)
seeds.oracle: pct = shares / (issued + ESOP_POOL); single 250k founder of 250k issued -> 33.33% (750k FD), NOT 100%

seeds.title: SAFE amount truncates shares*price to 2 decimals (sub-cent loss)
Cached total-issued-shares summary is updated on add but NOT re-derived on delete (stale aggregate)
seeds.oracle: captable:totalIssued (rendered at data-testid="total-issued") must always equal a fresh sum(shares) over the currently-persisted captable:founders array; after deleting a founder it must drop to the recomputed remaining total, not keep the pre-delete value

seeds.title: Founder named 'Ghost' fires green success toast but is NEVER persisted to localStorage
seeds.oracle: baking: read localStorage captable:founders back; the created founder must be present

seeds.title: Finalize flips status to COMPLETE and redirects UI but creates NO holdings rows
seeds.oracle: finalize must persist one holding per founder AND status COMPLETE; holdings must read back non-empty

seeds.title: Every 3rd Add-founder toasts success but silently drops the write (persists N-1)
seeds.oracle: multiplicity: create 3 -> read back exactly 3; a drop yields 2

seeds.title: Add-founder accepts a negative share count with no validation; ownership% goes negative and/or exceeds 100% for other rows
seeds.oracle: shares must be a positive quantity; a negative value must be rejected before persist, never fed into issuedTotal()/the ownership denominator

seeds.title: Adding a founder with 0 shares shows a false 'Founder added' success toast but persists nothing
seeds.oracle: baking: read localStorage captable:founders back; a 0-share submit must not add an entry, and the toast must not claim success

seeds.title: Helper text #b9b9b9 on white ~1.9:1 fails WCAG AA 4.5:1 (SC 1.4.3)
SAFE amount cell (max-width:90px, overflow:hidden) clips the computed value
16x16 icon button below WCAG 2.2 AA 24x24 target-size (SC 2.5.8)
Icon-only '?' button has no accessible name (axe button-name) AND throws a console error on click
Finalize panel: garish orange/magenta accents + erratic spacing, inconsistent with the rest of the app
SAFE amount for 1,000 shares @ $1.00/share computes AND persists exactly $1000.00 — MUST NOT be flagged
seeds.oracle: amount = shares * price = 1,000 * $1.00 = $1000.00 exactly; a whole-cent product, so F2's floor-to-cent truncation (Math.floor(shares*price*100)/100) causes zero loss on this specific input; captable:safeAmount reads back 1000 exactly

seeds.title: Primary button label #1a1a1a on #ffffff (~17:1) passes AA — MUST NOT be flagged
Editing a persisted founder DOES persist — MUST NOT be flagged as a silent drop
Finalize CTA sits below the fold with no visual affordance; primary action not discoverable
Amount column right-aligned, labels left-aligned, rows visually misread as unrelated
